tax.text: He voted for the One Big Beautiful Bill, which his office said avoided a large tax increase and cut taxes on tips and overtime.
tax.quote: Protects Coloradans from the largest tax increase in American history.

trade.text: Evans defended reciprocal tariffs as a way to protect American producers and create Colorado jobs.
trade.quote: Reciprocal tariffs ensure free and fair trade for American producers, including energy producers

debt.text: He says Social Security benefits seniors earned should be preserved and supports making them tax-free.
debt.quote: We must protect Social Security and I support efforts to make Social Security tax-free.

housing.text: He says government should reduce regulations that inhibit affordable housing construction.
housing.quote: I am working to make homeownership an attainable dream for every Coloradan by reducing regulations that inhibit affordable housing.

schools.text: He calls school choice a civil-rights issue and says children should not be trapped in underperforming schools because of their ZIP code.
schools.quote: School choice is one of the most important civil rights issues of our day.

safety.text: He advanced public-safety bills intended to strengthen law-enforcement coordination, intelligence-sharing and security resources.
safety.quote: As a former cop, I know that keeping our communities safe requires strong partnerships, timely intelligence-sharing, and making sure law enforcement has the tools they need to do their jobs.

immigration.text: He co-introduced legislation combining tougher border enforcement and E-Verify with earned legal status, Dreamer protections and new visa options.
immigration.quote: The Dignity Act provides a practical, compassionate solution to the immigration crisis by securing the border, upholding the law, strengthening the workforce, and ensuring immigrants who have been in America long-term and are following the rules can earn legal status through accountability and contribution.

guns.text: He said further gun-control laws would not make schools safer and called for more school resource officers and physical security.
guns.quote: And so I know that continuing to pass gun control isn't going to actually make our schools safer.

abortion.text: Evans identifies as pro-life and supports state-level abortion restrictions with exceptions, while opposing a national abortion ban.
abortion.quote: I am pro-life. I believe the Supreme Court was very clear when it made its decision a couple of years ago. They said this is an issue for the states to decide. So in Congress, I would not support a national abortion ban. I think it’s important to have exceptions.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Evans voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which applies sex-based eligibility rules to federally funded school athletics.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

health.text: He supports free-market competition, portability and price transparency in health insurance.
health.quote: This is also why I support free market policies, which will allow good competition and bring down costs.

energy.text: He supports increased domestic energy production, including drilling and the Keystone XL Pipeline, to lower costs and increase energy independence.
energy.quote: I support increasing domestic production of energy resources to ensure our energy independence and end our reliance on foreign countries.

voting.text: He supports voter-identification requirements and tighter checks intended to keep noncitizens off voter rolls.
voting.quote: Improvements can and should be made. For example, I support voter ID laws. And it is far too easy for non-citizens to end up on our voter rolls.

tax.text: He says money used for billionaire tax breaks should instead fund public-safety and community services.
tax.quote: The tax breaks for billionaires included in D.C. Republicans’ budget bill could have been spent on things Colorado communities actually need to stay safe.

wages.text: He supports raising the federal minimum wage and collective action by unions.
wages.quote: A strong middle class is essential for a healthy economy, and I’ll work to create good-paying jobs, raise the federal minimum wage, and ensure that all Americans have the opportunity to succeed.

trade.text: He opposes tariffs because he says they increase grocery and housing costs.
trade.quote: Trump’s tariffs drive up the cost of everyday goods like groceries and housing.

debt.text: He pledges to oppose Social Security or Medicare cuts and any increase in the retirement age.
debt.quote: If anyone tries to cut Social Security or Medicare or raise the retirement age, I’ll stop them.

housing.text: He supports federal incentives for zoning changes that permit more affordable housing near transit.
housing.quote: Rutinel said Congress should provide incentives for municipalities that agree to change zoning to allow for more affordable housing units to be built near transit stations.

immigration.text: He supports citizenship pathways for DREAMers and long-term immigrants while prioritizing enforcement against violent offenders.
immigration.quote: And we should provide a pathway to citizenship for the immigrants who have been here the longest and groups like DREAMers, while making sure we protect undocumented workers from exploitation.

guns.text: He cosponsored enacted legislation restricting semiautomatic weapons and rapid-fire devices.
guns.quote: SB25-003, to restrict semiautomatic weapons and rapid-fire devices in Colorado.

abortion.text: He says abortion decisions should be left to individuals rather than politicians.
abortion.quote: When it comes to abortion, the government needs to respect Americans’ freedom to make our own decisions about our own families without interference from politicians or anyone else.

health.text: He supports a public insurance option and expanding Medicare coverage to vision and dental care.
health.quote: Rutinel also supports a public health insurance option and agreed that Medicare needs more negotiating power. He added that Medicare plans should be expanded to include vision and dental coverage.

voting.text: He praises Colorado's mail-ballot system and wants its approach shared with other jurisdictions.
voting.quote: He praised Colorado's mail-in voting system, saying it has increased voter participation.
